title.narrative: Amazon Dossier: A study to unveil the violences to journalistic activity in the largest rainforest in the world

description.narrative: The project aims to create a front to combat violence against journalists and communicators in the Amazon. In addition to the expansion and dissemination of an analytical study, the intention is to develop activities such as a digital security workshop, a self-protection workshop and a legal protection seminar. The project also entails developing political advocacy initiatives, so that the information serves as a basis for the Brazilian State to implement public policies to guarantee the protection of those who work in the Amazon region. In the applicant’s perspective, strengthening and protecting journalist activity (mainly community/popular/independent) is a way of guaranteeing the protection of the environment and denouncing criminal and/or harmful practices to human life and the environment.
